newsitem.title: UK: Yieh Phui considers bond buyback.
newsitem.headline: Yieh Phui considers bond buyback.

text.p: Yieh Phui Enterprise Co Ltd, is considering ways in which it may repurchase its recent $90 million convertible bond issue at par, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
The company said it was aware of reports "concerning allegations that fraudulent invoices have been issued by the company," and that it strongly denied the reports.
But it said it was aware the allegations had caused concern to holders of the $90 million issue.
"Whilst denying that there has been any wrongdoing, the company is actively considering ways in which the bonds may be purchased at par," the statement said.
The company continues to hold approximately $60 million of the net proceeds of the issue of the bonds.
The company said it would make a further announcement as soon as possible, and by July 8, 1997 in any event.
"In the meantime these proceeds will not be disbursed," it said.
The $90 million convertible bond, has a 10-year maturity, a one percent coupon and was issued at par.
